g.text: Heap sort: extract the root, shrink the heap, repair it
A green array cell belongs to the sorted suffix. Dashed tree nodes lie outside the active heap.
1. Swap root 7 with the last active value 5
Both positions still belong to the heap before the swap.
2. Exclude index 6: heap size is now 6
7 is final. Root 5 breaks heap order because child 6 is larger.
3. Sift down: swap 5 with its larger child 6
The active tree is a max heap again; its next maximum is 6.
Repeat: after each extraction and heap repair
